title: Employ staff under the Local Government Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Local Government Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: Local Government Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the local government industry and their employees in the classifications listed in Schedule A —Classification Definitions to the exclusion of any other modern award.

sources.title: Local Government Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 Local government industry means all activities undertaken by local government entities, including activities undertaken by corporations controlled by one or more local government entities. In clause 4.2 a corporation is controlled by one or more local government entities if one or more local government entities have the capacity to determine the outcome of decisions about the corporation’s financial and operating policies.

confidence_note: Councils and the corporations they control (cl 4.2). The award reaches only councils in the national system, which differs by state; that is not yet coded.

assessment.summary: The Local Government Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
